protein: LbCas12a (Cas12a/Cpf1, type V-A CRISPR RNA-guided endonuclease)
assay_method: nanoDSF (differential scanning fluorimetry, intrinsic Trp fluorescence). Prometheus NT.48 (NanoTemper); 0.5 mg/ml protein in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl; 20-95 degC at 1 degC/min.
remark: Activity at 50 degC is reported for only WT and 5 variants, so it is not included.

protein: T7 RNA polymerase (single-subunit DNA-dependent RNA polymerase)
assay_method: Thermal shift assay / DSF with SYPRO Orange (5x). Analytik Jena qTower3; ~0.2 mg/ml protein, 20 ul, in triplicate; 25-65 degC in 0.5 degC steps with 5 s hold; Tm from a Boltzmann fit of the unfolding curve.
remark: P657L is excluded: no expression, no Tm. Activity at 52 degC is reported for only WT and 5 variants, so it is not included.

assay_method: Thermal shift assay / DSF with SYPRO Orange (5x). Analytik Jena qTower3; 0.3 mg/ml protein in 1x PBS; 25-85 degC in 0.5 degC steps with 5 s hold; Tm from a Boltzmann fit of the unfolding curve.

protein: VHH (camelid single-domain antibody against growth hormone), with C-terminal DDDDK-SGGGGS-His6 tag
readout: EC50(untreated) / EC50(24 h in 0.3 M NaOH), fold retained
assay_method: Indirect ELISA against plate-bound growth hormone (5 ng/well); VHH incubated in 0.3 M NaOH for 24 h and neutralized with HCl, then serial dilutions 1:2 to 1:2048, HRP secondary, TMB, A450; EC50 from a four-parameter log(agonist)-response fit.
remark: Readout is EC50(untreated)/EC50(treated), computed from the two EC50 columns the source reports separately, so that higher is better.

protein: Phi29 DNA polymerase (highly processive strand-displacing B-family DNA polymerase with 3'-5' proofreading exonuclease)
assay_method: Differential scanning fluorimetry (DSF) with SYPRO Orange (Protein Thermal Shift Dye Kit, Thermo Fisher). Roche LightCycler 480 II; 19 ul of 0.1 mg/ml protein in 25 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 500 mM NaCl plus 1 ul diluted dye; 25-99 degC at 0.05 degC/s; Tm from Protein Thermal Shift software.
remark: Supplementary Table 1 prints two rounds of top-20 predictions (ESM-1v zero-shot, and ESM-1v after FSFP training) as two side-by-side ranked blocks; they are merged into one dataset here. T441L, G245V, V130L and C290K appear in both blocks with identical Tm values and are kept once. Sequence is the native 575-aa polymerase (UniProt P03680), which mutation numbering verifies against; the pET28a N-terminal His-tag of the assayed construct is not included, as its sequence is not given.
